audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all Island South event records, including Leo’s move to Stardew Valley and the island rescue text. Every line, question, choice, and branch response was reviewed in full event context with canonical Leo, Linus, Stardew Valley and island terminology and distinct character voices. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, mail and friendship conditions, response branches and counts, placeholders, emotes, sound and music IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. One command-only transition record is explicitly preserved. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
